description: This Java class implements a service for managing images associated with clients and staff within a Fineract-based application. It handles saving, updating, and deleting images in a content repository, and maintains references in domain objects such as Client and Staff.

classes.name: ImageWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for managing images related to clients and staff, including saving, updating, and deleting images in persistent storage.

methods.name: saveOrUpdateImage
methods.description: Saves or updates an image for a specified entity (client or staff) using an InputStream.

methods.name: saveOrUpdateImage
methods.description: Saves or updates an image for a specified entity (client or staff) using a Base64EncodedImage object.

methods.name: deleteImage
methods.description: Deletes an image associated with a specified entity.

methods.name: deletePreviousImage
methods.description: Removes the previous image associated with the entity, if any.

methods.name: updateImage
methods.description: Associates a new image with the owner (client or staff) and persists changes.

methods.name: createImage
methods.description: Creates a new Image object or updates an existing one with the given location and storage type.
